schedule.note: CDFW's 2026 Provisional Stocking Document for Trout and Inland Salmon lists Pit River South Fork (Modoc Co.) — the South Fork reach upstream of the Highway 395 bridge in Likely — for catchable-size Rainbow Trout under the Put and Take program, with a stated release month range of May-June. This is CDFW's provisional plan for 2026, not a guaranteed annual constant.
